description: Offer to buy a domain listed with GoMain. Offers at or above the asking price buy it outright; lower offers are negotiated automatically with a counter-offer, for up to three rounds, then the seller decides. An accepted offer opens an Escrow.com transaction, so the money is only released once the domain arrives. Confirm the amount and email with the user before calling; to answer a counter-offer, pass the deal_id and status_key from the last answer.
name: make_offer
title: Make an offer on a GoMain listing
